        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_AppealHearing</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_SendAppealDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="U_Start" name="Application received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="U_Start_Def" messageRef="Msg_Application"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="U_MergeReview" name="Review pending"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T_Review" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_DocsComplete" name="Documents complete?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="U_NotifyMissing" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="U_IE_MissingItems" name="Missing items received">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UF30" sourceRef="T_Accounts" targetRef="U_GW_Join2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UF31" sourceRef="U_GW_Join2" targetRef="U_SemMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UF32" sourceRef="U_SemMerge" targetRef="U_Semester"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UF33" sourceRef="U_Semester" targetRef="T_PostGrades"/>
